user.title: Choose your mesh radio
user.description: Select the software running on the gateway you want to add.

data_description.protocol: Choose Meshtastic or MeshCore. You can add more gateways before finishing.

connection.title: How is {protocol} connected?
connection.description: Choose a connection Home Assistant can reach. Advanced bridge methods require decoded JSON.

gateway.title: Connect the gateway
gateway.description: Set up {protocol} using {transport}. Only fields needed by this connection are shown.

data.name: Gateway name
data.mqtt_node_id: Gateway node number for MQTT sends (optional)

data_description.host: This address is reached from Home Assistant, which may be inside a container.
data_description.serial_path: Choose a detected USB device. For an advanced mapping, type the exact Home Assistant-visible path, such as /dev/serial/by-id/usb-YOUR_RADIO.
data_description.ble_address: Direct SDK Bluetooth requires a local adapter; remote Bluetooth proxies are not supported.
data_description.mqtt_topic: Meshtastic must point to its /json/ topic. MeshCore requires a compatible decoded-JSON bridge.
data_description.publish_topic: For Meshtastic, use the exact .../2/json/mqtt/ downlink topic. Leave blank for receive-only.
data_description.mqtt_node_id: Decimal node ID of the Meshtastic gateway that transmits MQTT downlinks.
data_description.verify_connection: Recommended. Turn this off only when intentionally configuring an offline gateway.

pair_intro.title: Pair the Meshtastic radio
pair_intro.description: Close the Meshtastic phone app, wake the radio, and keep its screen visible. Continuing starts one time-limited pairing request for the selected local radio.

data.ready_to_pair: I am ready to start pairing

pair_pin.title: Enter the radio's Bluetooth PIN
pair_pin.description: Enter the six-digit code now shown by a RANDOM_PIN radio, or the configured fixed code for a screenless radio. The code expires shortly and is never saved by MeshNet.

settings.title: Finish MeshNet setup
settings.description: MeshNet will start with {gateway_count} gateway(s). These defaults work well for most networks.

abort.already_configured: MeshNet is already configured. Open its Configure dialog to manage gateways.
abort.invalid_import: The imported MeshNet configuration is invalid. Check gateway IDs and transport fields.
abort.invalid_discovery: The Bluetooth discovery did not contain a safe device address.
abort.bluetooth_requires_gui: Meshtastic Bluetooth must be added through the MeshNet setup wizard so the local bond can be verified safely.
abort.pairing_state_lost: The time-limited Bluetooth pairing request ended. Start pairing again.

progress.pairing: Starting a protected pairing request for the selected local radio…
progress.verifying_pairing: Verifying the Bluetooth bond and Meshtastic service…

error.cannot_connect: Home Assistant could not reach this gateway. Check its address, port, device mapping, and permissions, or turn off the connection test to save an offline gateway.
error.invalid_auth: The gateway rejected the API key.
error.missing_dependency: This method needs another Home Assistant integration. Configure MQTT first, then try again.
error.invalid_gateway: The gateway settings are incomplete, duplicated, or invalid for this radio and connection method.
error.bluez_unavailable: Home Assistant could not open the local BlueZ pairing service. Bluetooth proxies and remote adapters cannot perform this pairing.
error.local_adapter_required: The selected radio was not found on a local BlueZ adapter. Bluetooth proxy-only devices cannot be paired here.
error.not_meshtastic_device: The selected Bluetooth device did not expose the Meshtastic service.
error.pairing_cancelled: The pairing request was cancelled. Wake the radio and start again.
error.pairing_cleanup_incomplete: BlueZ may have kept the bond after verification failed. Cancel this setup and restart Bluetooth before retrying; MeshNet will not automatically delete an ambiguous bond.
error.pairing_ownership_pending: Another MeshNet pairing flow still controls this radio. Finish or cancel that flow before retrying; restart Home Assistant if that flow is no longer open.
error.pairing_confirmation_required: Confirm that the radio is ready before pairing.
error.pairing_failed: Bluetooth pairing failed safely without saving the gateway.
error.pairing_rate_limited: Too many pairing requests were started for this radio. Wait about 10 minutes before trying again.
error.pairing_rejected: The radio or BlueZ rejected the pairing request. Check the PIN, close other clients, and try again.
error.pairing_timeout: The pairing request expired. Start again promptly; if asked for a PIN, enter the displayed code within about 50 seconds.

remove_gateway.title: Remove a gateway
remove_gateway.description: This removes the connection from MeshNet. Bluetooth cleanup is optional and off by default; removing the radio's current BlueZ bond may disconnect other apps that use it.

data.confirm: I understand and want to remove this gateway
data.remove_bluetooth_bond: Remove this radio's current Bluetooth bond (may disconnect other apps)
